verdict.rationale: Consensus's core interaction model is natural-language search/synthesis over academic papers — users type questions and get AI-synthesized, cited answers, positioning it as an 'AI-native alternative to Google Scholar' (consensus-docs-5, consensus-docs-10, consensus-docs-11). This is the primary way users operate the product. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands driving other actions beyond search/synthesis (e.g., managing the library, running automated workflows via chat) and independent/hands-on confirmation of the NL interface quality.
